title: One continuous path, a finite set of targets
caption: Normalized alignment schematic. Target chunks sample a continuous source path at original character midpoints; a short target can miss narrow changes in a long source trajectory.

title: Contrastive calibration supplies three directions
caption: Calibration workflow. Small hand-authored contrasts estimate steering directions; normalization neither orthogonalizes them nor establishes emotional validity.

title: Controls shape the activation displacement
caption: Control pipeline. Axis controls operate on three emotional coefficients, not vocabulary logits. Raising budget has no effect while the proposal already lies below the ceiling.
provenance: Explanatory schematic derived from the report; not a screenshot or new experiment.

title: A change to both feed-forward branches
caption: Hook implementation schematic. The final prompt token and current cached-decoding token receive the intervention; hooks are removed on exit. Hosted API mode instead uses coordinate-bearing instructions.

title: Verification is a separate assessment
caption: Verification workflow. Failed or direction-unknown assessments are not assigned invented scores, and this score is not an iterative feedback objective during rewriting.
